items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Who was in Charlie Tolles' band? ... And a fella named Johnson. ... So, we, we killed a rotten band over there.

ctx.x: Oh, we didn't get her by Charlie Tolles' band. Who was in Charlie Tolles' band? Who was in Charlie Tolles' band?

Who was in Charlie Tolles' band? Oh, me. At the age. And a fella named, this fella I'll tell you about Moran. And a fella named Johnson. And see, he had his wife playing piano. And a fella playing Clowness named Johnson. So, we, we killed a rotten band over there. You see, it wasn't our fault. Charlie Tolles had his band. And when they said he was going to Mexico, well, his band backed out. And he just had to grab anybody he could get to go. So, he got I-Ted and my-Ted got me. And then my-Ted got the, uh, the…
Ask him who danced the Charleston. Who danced it? Yeah, over there in Mexico.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Son Johnson, you know that? You know Son Johnson, a saxophone player?

ctx.x: Oliver? Oliver? He used to play with them. He used to play with me sometime on the job. but I was a saxophone player. All of them? Yeah. All of them? Yeah, he used to play with, Hickory used to play with him, you see. He used to play with me some time on the job. You know Joe was in there, huh? The drummer, and Henry was in there. Son Johnson, you know that? You know Son Johnson, a saxophone player? Oh, yeah. Where's every artist you know him? He teaches now. He teaches somebody down in the conservatory a long…
That's right. He knows Son Fuclos. Did you know Son Fuclos?
